encoding.note: Map texture G = floorH + floorOffset *255, B = (ceilH - ceilOffset)*255. Decode: fh = G-0.5, ch = B/255+0.7

fallback.note: When DDA misses (out of bounds), use fallback heights for floor/ceiling plane intersect

refinement.note: Floor/ceiling height refined by sampling mapTex 3 times along ray
